compose_attach_no_draft: Open the draft you want to attach files to first.
compose_command_forward_description: Forward the current message in the compose editor
compose_command_open_drafts_description: View and resume locally saved drafts
compose_command_reply_all_description: Reply to the sender and all recipients inline
compose_confirm_attachment_title: The message mentions an attachment, but none is attached
compose_confirm_discard_body: The draft and its new attachments are removed from this computer; the original files aren't deleted.
compose_confirm_reload_body: Unsaved input in this window will be replaced. Consider copying the draft content first.
compose_confirm_reload_title: Replace your current input with the saved version?
compose_confirm_resolve_body: Unlock only after checking. Unlocking doesn't send the message.
compose_confirm_send_body: Make sure everything is right before sending.
compose_copy_failed: Can't access the clipboard. Select the text in the editor and copy it.
compose_drafts_empty_body: Messages you haven't finished stay here.
compose_drafts_note: Drafts are stored by the background service on this computer, so you can keep editing after closing the window. They don't sync to other devices yet.
compose_empty_body: Start with New message on the left, or open a draft.
compose_error_attach_draft_changed: The attachment is ready, but the draft content changed. Reload it and check.
compose_error_attachments_not_ready: Finish, fix, or remove attachments that aren't ready first.
compose_error_close_sending: The message is being sent. Wait for the delivery result.
compose_error_close_uploads: Attachments are still being prepared. Finish or cancel them before closing the window.
compose_error_conflict_elsewhere: This draft was changed elsewhere. Reload it and check the content first.
compose_error_context_changed: The draft being edited changed. Confirm which draft to send again.
compose_error_generic: The action didn't finish. Try again.
compose_error_no_sender: No sending account yet. Set one up in account settings first.
compose_error_not_saved: The draft isn't saved yet. Keep this window open and try again.
compose_error_offline_kept: The background service isn't connected. Your changes are kept in this window.
compose_error_send_uncertain: Delivery isn't confirmed yet. Check your sent mail; don't just send it again.
compose_error_uploads_pending: Finish or remove the attachments being prepared first.
compose_failed_note: The message wasn't sent. Check the sending identity, the mailbox connection, and the recipients, then try again.
compose_field_bcc_placeholder: Other recipients won't see these addresses
compose_hint_offline: Background service not connected; your input stays in this window
compose_html_convert: Convert to plain text and edit
compose_html_note: This draft has HTML formatting. The editor supports plain text only; converting removes the draft's HTML version.
compose_recipient_edit_hint: Double-click or press Enter to edit
compose_sending_note: Waiting for the delivery result. You can keep reading mail, but don't send it again.
compose_sent_archived: A copy was queued for sync.
compose_sent_not_archived: A copy wasn't queued for sync. Check the Sent folder later.
compose_unknown_body: Check the Sent folder or confirm with the recipients first. Sending again may create a duplicate.
compose_validate_address_control_char: Recipient addresses can't contain control characters.
compose_validate_address_invalid: Enter full email addresses, separated by commas.
compose_validate_address_too_long: Each email address can't exceed 320 bytes.
compose_validate_body_too_long: The message body can't be larger than 256 KiB.
compose_validate_sender_unavailable: This sending identity isn't available right now. Set up SMTP or choose another account.
compose_validate_simple_sender: This sending service supports only plain text to a single recipient: no Cc/Bcc or attachments.
compose_validate_subject_too_long: The subject can't be longer than 998 bytes.
compose_validate_too_many_recipients: You can't have more than 100 recipients in total.
